feedback.issue: Unsafe Composer installer: Downloads and pipes installer script directly to PHP without checksum verification. Vulnerable to MITM attacks and supply chain compromise.
feedback.suggestion: Verify installer integrity before execution. Add checksum validation: curl -O installer && curl -O installer.sha512 && sha512sum -c installer.sha512 && php installer && rm installer.sha512. Alternatively, use multi-stage build: COPY --from=composer:2.6 /usr/bin/composer /usr/local/bin/composer

feedback.issue: Unsafe WP-CLI installation: No checksum verification for downloaded phar file. Compromised download could inject malicious code.
feedback.suggestion: Add SHA512 verification: curl -O wp-cli.phar && curl -O wp-cli.phar.sha512 && sha512sum -c wp-cli.phar.sha512 && chmod +x wp-cli.phar && mv wp-cli.phar /usr/local/bin/wp && rm wp-cli.phar.sha512

feedback.issue: bc calculations without error handling. Silent failures if bc not available or arithmetic fails. Returns empty strings instead of errors, propagating to cost reports.
feedback.suggestion: Check bc availability at script start: if ! command -v bc &>/dev/null; then log_error 'bc required'; exit 1; fi. Wrap calculations with error handling: cpu_hours=$(echo 'scale=4; ...' | bc) || { log_error 'calculation failed'; return 1; }

feedback.issue: Unquoted variable expansion in sed could allow regex injection if variables contain special characters like . * [ ]
feedback.suggestion: Use bash parameter expansion instead of sed: cpu='${cpu%\%}' to remove trailing %. Or escape sed input: cpu=$(echo "${cpu//\\/\\\\}" | sed 's/%$//') for safer substitution

feedback.issue: Missing layer caching optimization. Entrypoint script copy comes after npm install. If entrypoint changes, Docker rebuilds unnecessary layers, wasting build time (10-15% impact).
feedback.suggestion: Reorder layers: (1) apk install, (2) user/perms, (3) workspace, (4) COPY entrypoint, (5) npm install. This ensures frequently-changing files are copied last to maximize cache hits.

feedback.issue: Missing input validation. Team names and dates not validated before use in docker commands. Could allow injection attacks: by-team "'; rm -rf /; echo '"
feedback.suggestion: Add validation functions: validate_team_name() { [[ $1 =~ ^[a-z0-9_-]+$ ]] || [[ $1 == 'all' ]] || return 1; }. Call before processing: validate_team_name "$team" || { log_error 'invalid team'; return 1; }

feedback.issue: Subshell race condition in quota_check(). Pipe creates subshell; overall_ok=false inside subshell doesn't affect parent. Function always reports 'all teams within quotas' even when violations exist.
feedback.suggestion: Replace pipe with process substitution: while read ... < <(get_running_container_stats). This avoids subshell, allowing parent variables to be modified correctly. Accumulate errors in array: errors+=("message") and report after loop.

feedback.issue: No integration tests between teams. Each team image validated in isolation. Missing tests for: team coexistence on same network, Redis isolation, environment variable leakage, cross-team data access.
feedback.suggestion: Create docker-compose.integration.yml with eng, marketing, data agents connecting to same Redis. Verify: (1) agents don't see other teams' job queues, (2) team labels properly isolate visibility, (3) network policies work as designed. Add 5-10 integration tests.

feedback.issue: Inconsistent documentation references to docker-build skill. README shows examples without --no-cache flag, but build-all-teams.sh uses ${NO_CACHE} variable. Users don't know --no-cache is available until reading script.
feedback.suggestion: Add note in QUICK_START.md: 'For advanced options (--no-cache, --push), see build-all-teams.sh or scripts/build-team.sh for complete examples with variable expansion support.'

feedback.issue: Missing cost allocation documentation. 567-line cost-allocation-tracker.sh has only inline comments, no markdown guide. Users don't understand cost model (CPU=$0.05/core/hr, Memory=$0.10/GB/hr, provider multipliers).
feedback.suggestion: Create docs/COST_ALLOCATION_TRACKING.md covering: cost model assumptions, provider pricing matrix (Z.ai, Kimi, etc.), team quotas, example reports, CSV export format, and troubleshooting quota violations.

feedback.issue: Loose dependency pinning on system packages. Alpine python3 without version can jump minor versions between rebuilds, causing inconsistency across team members.
feedback.suggestion: Pin to specific version: python3.11=3.11.8-r0 or use apk info python3 to find exact version tag. Apply same pinning to python3-dev, py3-pip for consistency.

feedback.issue: Inconsistent version pinning. Jupyter hardcoded (jupyterlab==4.0.9) but other libraries unpinned. Should either pin all or pin none for consistency.
feedback.suggestion: Either: (1) Move jupyterlab to requirements.txt with pinned version, or (2) Remove hardcoded version from Dockerfile and let requirements.txt manage all versions. Recommend option 1 for reproducible builds.

feedback.issue: No validation that team Dockerfile exists before attempting docker build. Fails with cryptic docker error instead of clear message.
feedback.suggestion: Check file existence: if [[ ! -f "docker/teams/${team}/Dockerfile" ]]; then log_error "Dockerfile not found"; exit 1; fi. Add similar check for Dockerfile.base before the loop.

feedback.issue: No reference to .dockerignore in Dockerfile comments. Project has .dockerignore and .dockerignore.production but Dockerfile doesn't mention them.
feedback.suggestion: Add comment in Dockerfile.base: '# See .dockerignore for excluded files. Use .dockerignore.production in CI/CD builds for smaller context.'

feedback.issue: Inconsistent file organization. Base entrypoint at base/entrypoint.sh but team scripts in team/scripts/init.sh. No consistent pattern for where scripts live.
feedback.suggestion: Standardize: Move base/entrypoint.sh to base/scripts/entrypoint.sh. Create base/scripts/init.sh if needed. All scripts in scripts/ subdirectories for consistency.

feedback.issue: Label inconsistency across images. Base has 'version' and 'maintainer', team images have 'cost-center'. Should be standardized.
feedback.suggestion: Standardize all labels: version, maintainer, team, cost-center, description. Base should have cost-center='base-000' for consistency. Applied to all Dockerfiles.

feedback.issue: Unsafe head usage. Shows only first 10 cfn-agent images; if more exist, silently truncates output without indication.
feedback.suggestion: Use docker images --filter: docker images --filter 'reference=cfn-agent*' --format 'table {{.Repository}}\t{{.Tag}}\t{{.Size}}'. Shows all images with proper formatting.

feedback.issue: Vague Docker registry example. Shows 'myregistry.com' without guidance on actual registry formats (Docker.io, ECR, private registries).
feedback.suggestion: Clarify: 'Docker.io: docker.io/company. AWS ECR: 123456789.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com. Google Artifact Registry: us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/project. Private: registry.company.com'

feedback.issue: No secret management validation. Script accepts provider names but doesn't check if required API keys are available in environment.
feedback.suggestion: Add validate_provider_secrets() function. Check that ZAI_API_KEY, KIMI_API_KEY, etc. are set before using provider. Call validate_provider_secrets "$provider" || exit 1 in relevant functions.

feedback.issue: Long USER root sections create privilege escalation windows. Example: Marketing runs as root for 30+ lines before switching to cfn.
feedback.suggestion: Minimize root sections: Group all root operations together, explicitly chown any created resources, immediately switch to USER cfn. Add comment: '# Operations after this point run as cfn user'

feedback.issue: Security scanning is optional in validate tests. Trivy scan skipped if not installed, but security scans should be mandatory in CI/CD.
feedback.suggestion: Check if running in CI: if [[ "${CI:-false}" == "true" ]]; then if ! command -v trivy &>/dev/null; then exit 1; fi. Make scans fail in CI, warn only in local development.
